author: myanmar_remaining_repair_bulk

method.basis: Manual visual interpretation of all 474 exact native centre pixels in unlabelled RGB and NIR/red/green saved PNGs, plus literal per-band values and source masks. All 16 contact sheets and all 11 focus sheets were viewed.
method.coordinates: local_pixel and source_pixel are [row,column]; display coordinates are (column,row).
method.display: Native saved DN0..3000 rendering; 41x41 native-pixel crops enlarged by nearest neighbour. Marks bracket the centre without covering the centre pixel. No dense centre-label imagery used.
method.axis_correction: An initial transposed display was discarded before any answer roster was authored. All retained contact/focus sheets and this roster use [row,column] correctly.
method.quality: SCL is literal 20 m source classification/quality context, not physical truth. Source masks are literal validity context, not independent surface evidence.
method.independence: Main earlier interpretation proposals were not used to assign answers. Reviewer challenges were examined against actual unlabelled centre pixels.

limits: Proposed dated 10 m source-pixel observations only; independent combined review remains pending.
No whole approximately 150 m original-cell surface classification, annual persistence, legal ownership, source authority, native qualification or repair acceptance is asserted.
No new source retrieval, geometry predicate, shoreline extraction, producer/qualifier replay or scientific classifier was run.
The original remote COG was sampled in native windows; the saved window hashes do not constitute a hash of the whole remote COG.
